data.title: Launch Two moves NuCube microreactor SPAC deal forward
data.description:
An update from Launch Two Acquisition Corp. Class A ( (LPBB) ) is now available.

NuCube Energy and Launch Two Acquisition Corp., a special purpose acquisition company, are advancing a proposed merger that would take NuCube’s advanced nuclear microreactor business public, following their June 25, 2026 announcement of a Business Combination Agreement. NuCube’s integrated model around its passively safe NuSun solid-state microreactor is aimed at delivering carbon-free power and process heat with lower costs and simplified licensing, potentially positioning it competitively within the emerging advanced nuclear sector.

On September 11, 2026, Launch Two publicly filed a Form S-4 registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, naming NuCube as co-registrant, and the parties disclosed this filing on September 15, 2026, marking a key procedural step toward closing the transaction. Completion of the business combination remains subject to approval by Launch Two’s shareholders and NuCube’s stockholders and other customary conditions, so investors will be watching regulatory progress and shareholder votes as indicators of whether NuCube’s microreactor strategy can access public capital markets via this SPAC deal.

data.description:

On September 14, 2026, 5E Advanced Materials and its subsidiary 5E SVM entered an agreement to acquire Searles Valley Minerals’ key operating assets through a court-supervised Section 363 bankruptcy sale in Delaware. The deal covers production facilities at Argus, Westend and Trona, more than 9,000 acres of Searles Lake brine resources, the Trona Railway short-line railroad, water infrastructure and related utilities, permits and contracts in San Bernardino County, California.

The consideration totals about $3.4 million in cash, 8.3 million shares of 5E common stock and an approximately $6.2 million senior unsecured promissory note, with 5E SVM also assuming specified environmental compliance obligations and other liabilities tied to the assets.
